name: @git-library/mcp

tools.name: list_libraries
tools.description: List all available knowledge libraries with their metadata. Returns detailed info including doc counts, AI coverage, and sizes.

tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Full-text search within knowledge libraries. Returns matching documents with path, title, summary, and excerpt. Strongly recommend specifying library_id for best precision.

library_id.description: Strongly recommended. The library ID to search in. Specifying this greatly improves precision and speed. If omitted, falls back to auto-routing (less precise).

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: Read the complete content of a specific document from a library, including its Markdown body and Frontmatter metadata.

path.description: The relative path of the document within the library (e.g., 'guides/mcp-config.md')

tools.name: get_library_manifest
tools.description: Get the complete index/manifest of a library, including all document titles, summaries, tags, and paths. Use this when you need to browse a library's full table of contents.

tools.name: check_recent_updates
tools.description: Check recently updated documents across one or all libraries. Filters by last_updated timestamp.

library_id.description: Optional: specific library ID to check. If omitted, checks all libraries.

days.description: Number of days to look back for updates
